task.description: Implement the ISS-0147 fix per the validated design.

result.summary: Added tests/support/python_interp.zig + tests/unit/python_interp_test.zig, rewired both call sites, wired the module and unit tests into build.zig. Two implementation-time corrections: the process-lifetime cache was first backed by the caller's allocator, which crashed under Zig's per-test allocator model (invalid free across test blocks) -- now backed by page_allocator; and the module was first placed in tests/integration/, which tripped lint_test_isolation T020/T050 as an accurate misplacement signal -- now in tests/support/ as a named module, also required because Zig rejects @import across module roots.
